title: yaks names keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/names adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `by_name` makes its entities addressable by the name a person types — an author is found by typing "Ursula Le Guin", whereas a review is not found by the sentence it opens with.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [nameKeywords]).

by_name.description: true = this component's entities are addressable by name, read from the vocabulary's default name property (`title`). A string names a different property instead: "by_name": "label" reads the name from `label`.
